title: TraceX engine result, input of the data kit scorer
description: What `python -m datakit score --result` reads. Independent of the engine's internal types and of the API contract: an adapter maps the engine's entities and SAME_AS edges to this shape. Entity ids are opaque and are never used to match ground truth; entities map by mention lines and value (spec section 8.1).

batches_loaded.description: Batches loaded and matched before this result was taken. Expected links whose batch_min is later are skipped.

harness_applied.description: Ids of ground-truth scenarios[] whose human actions were applied before this result was taken (for example HS-AC13). Expected links that name a harness not listed here are skipped.

edges.description: Every stored SAME_AS edge, in any state. A pair the engine scored Low and did not store has no edge.

file.description: File name inside the case directory, e.g. notes.txt, cdr-02.csv

raw_text.description: The text as written. PERSON and ORG map on this.

normalized.description: The engine's normalized form. PHONE, ACCOUNT and VEHICLE map on this.

mentions.description: Every source line that writes this entity

gate.description: A failed gate: its id (G1..G7), or an object with the template key for G6 sub-cases. Compared as a set.

b.description: Entity id; endpoint order does not matter

score.description: A number or a decimal string; compared by decimal equality where ground truth says exact

sources.description: Every (case, file, line) the edge's explanation cites
